target: observe_prune.sh — gzip rotation is lossless for every reader
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; cp "$FIXTURES/obs-events.jsonl" .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl; BEFORE="$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" cost)"; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_prune.sh" --days 0 >/dev/null; AFTER="$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" cost)"; RENDER_OK=false; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_render.sh" --tty --run r1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && RENDER_OK=true; GZ=false; [ -f .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl.gz ] && [ ! -f .agentic/observability/events-20260728.jsonl ] && GZ=true; jq -n --argjson b "$BEFORE" --argjson a "$AFTER" --argjson gz "$GZ" --argjson r "$RENDER_OK" '{same: ($b == $a), usd: $a.metered_usd, gz: $gz, render: $r}'
